title: LoRA Adapter from Scratch
summary: Wrap a frozen linear layer with a trainable low-rank update ΔW = (α/r)·BA, derive its gradients by hand, merge it back for free inference, and fit a low-rank target with a fraction of the parameters.

ShapeMismatch.hint: Write the shapes down: W (d_out, d_in), A (r, d_in), B (d_out, r), x (N, d_in). Every matmul has to contract matching axes.

NaNInSoftmax.hint: The loss blew up to inf or NaN. Check that the gradient is scaled by 1/N (mean, not sum) and that α/r is applied exactly once.

hints.test_init_shapes_and_zero_B: A is (r, d_in), drawn as rng.standard_normal((r, d_in)) / sqrt(d_in) from np.random.default_rng(seed). B is np.zeros((d_out, r)). scale = alpha / r.
hints.test_init_output_equals_base_layer: With B = 0 the update B @ A is exactly zero, so a fresh adapter reproduces x @ W.T. If the output moved, B wasn't zero-initialized.
hints.test_forward_matches_reference: forward = x @ W.T + (alpha / r) * (x @ A.T) @ B.T. Don't forget the alpha / r factor.
hints.test_backward_matches_finite_differences: With h = x @ A.T: dB = scale * grad_out.T @ h and dA = scale * (grad_out @ B).T @ x.
hints.test_backward_grads_only_for_A_and_B: Return exactly {'A': ..., 'B': ...}. W is frozen and must never receive a gradient. backward should raise RuntimeError while merged.
hints.test_merge_matches_unmerged_and_unmerge_: merge sets W = W + scale * B @ A once (check self.merged), unmerge subtracts it. Copy W in __init__ with np.array(W, dtype=float) so the caller's array is never touched.
hints.test_parameter_counts: LoRA trains r·d_in + d_out·r numbers. Full fine-tuning trains every entry of W: d_in·d_out.
hints.test_training_fits_low_rank_target: Each step: pred = forward(X), loss = mean((pred − Y)²), grad_out = 2 (pred − Y) / pred.size, then backward and step. Record the loss before updating.
hints.test_training_keeps_base_frozen: step should update only the parameters named in grads, and backward should only ever name A and B.
